data.narrative:
Tenna Systems is a Seed-stage frontier-tech company in Defense & Security founded by Avner Bendheim and Gabriel Bendheim, having raised $13.5M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies—2 public and 8 private—operating in the same sector and stage cohort, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods apply to this analysis. Stage-progression methodology uses total capital raised ($14M) as a proxy base value and applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, yielding $34M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The dispersion reflects heterogeneity in Stage A funding and market positioning within defense tech.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $29M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $517M. The wide spread reflects meaningful uncertainty around both appropriate stage-based growth multiples for frontier defense tech and the applicability of higher-valued Series A comps to an early-stage entrant. Key variables affecting resolution include nearterm fundraising stage, revenue trajectory, and defense sector consolidation dynamics.
